# rt/time

> Time: a monotonic clock in nanoseconds, and durations as text.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/time.pkg)

```
let start = time_now()
work()
print time_fmt(time_now() - start)      // e.g. "27 ms"
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `time_now() -> int` | nanoseconds on the monotonic clock (`clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC)`) |
| `time_fmt(ns: int) -> str` | `"412 µs"` below 1 ms, `"27 ms"` below 10 s, else `"12.3 s"` (truncated) |

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
fn time_now() -> int
  let ts = make([int], 2)
  syscall(228, 1, &ts[0])
  return ts[0] * 1000000000 + ts[1]
end

fn time_fmt(ns: int) -> str
  if ns < 1000000
    return str_concat(str_from_int(ns / 1000), " µs")
  elif ns < 10000000000
    return str_concat(str_from_int(ns / 1000000), " ms")
  end
  let tenths = ns / 100000000
  let s = str_concat(str_from_int(tenths / 10), ".")
  return str_concat(str_concat(s, str_from_int(tenths % 10)), " s")
end
```
